correctness.rationale: For K_(2m), Edmonds matching inequalities give |E| coordinate facets and 2^(n-2)-n complementary nontrivial odd-cut facets, all primitive with respect to the explicitly saturated lattice Lambda=ker unsigned incidence. Since dimension d=|E|-n, the toric exact divisor sequence gives global class rank 2^(n-2), and integral coordinate restrictions span the dual lattice, excluding torsion. At matching M, precisely 2m(m-1) offmatching coordinate facets and m(2^(m-1)-2) odd facets meet, giving local class rank m(2^(m-1)-1) and integrality from offmatching coordinates. Rational support-function matching constraints require all vertex sums equal, giving Picard rank one and Pic=Z. Canonical Q-Cartier height on a blossom triple containing a matching edge evaluates n-4 rather than 1, a contradiction for m>=3. Independently checked all 15 K6 matching vertices, affine dimension 9, 25 facets and local rank 9 by exact-rational ranks. Finite K6 evidence does not replace the all-m matching-facet and lattice arguments.
